author: Andrea Wright
text: I find it seems to happen to me whenever there are rapid fluctuations in blood sugar, which is every time I exercise. I can't comprehend how there are world class athletes with T1 diabetes - how on earth do they fuel appropriately and not constantly run the risk of hypos?!

author: Helen Coyle Rose
text: I spoke to a guy from Abbott about this recently and he said it’s due to rapid fluctuations in glucose levels. He said if it continues for over 2 hours, the sensor shuts down.
